August 26 39.

Inspector Port Police,
Port Said.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. T/P 2307 dated July 22, 1939,
and in reply to inform you that the letter
addressed to Mrs. Cilly Meyer has been duly
delivered to her. Her address is : Lane 150,
House 2, Room 8, Wayside Road, Shanghai.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为手写签名〕
Deputy Commissioner of Police
in Charge.

（批：Rdy. 26/8.）

The Chief of Police,
Shanghai.
----------------------

Dear Sir,

Would you be so kind as to
have the enclosed letter delivered to Mrs.
Cilly Meyer, who gives her address as c/o
Messrs. The Lloyd Triestino, Shanghai.

This person has written
several times to the local Jewish Committee
to enquire about her mother who was landed
into hospital here from the s.s. "CONTE VERDE"
in March last.

The mother, RECHA GUMPEL-FURST,
died on 15.3.1939, and although the letters of
Mrs. Cilly Meyer have been replied to by the
Jewish Committee, evidently none of them have
been received by her.

I am, dear Sir,
Yours faithfully,

〔此处转录不清〕

Bimbashi,
Inspector Port Police.

致：
上海警务处长。
---

亲爱的先生：

能否劳烦您将随信附上的信件递交给西莉·迈耶（Cilly Meyer）女士，她提供的地址是转交上海意大利邮船公司（Messrs. The Lloyd Triestino, Shanghai）。

此人曾多次致函本地犹太委员会，查询其母亲的下落。其母于去年三月从“孔特·韦尔德”号（s.s. "CONTE VERDE"）轮船在此登岸后入院。

其母雷查·贡佩尔-弗斯特（RECHA GUMPEL-FURST）于1939年3月15日去世，尽管犹太委员会已回复了西莉·迈耶女士的来信，但显然她并未收到任何回信。

此致，
敬礼

〔此处转录不清〕

宾巴希（Bimbashi，土耳其军衔，相当于少校/警监），
港口警务督察官。

5422-D
8 7 39

July 6 39.

Dr. Kurt Marx,
Secretary,
Committee For The Assistance of European
Jewish Refugees in Shanghai,
Disbursement and Housing Committee,
1 South Tiendong Road.

Sir,

With reference to your letter dated
June 19, 1939, enquiries have been made but no
trace can be found of Mrs. Ella CHU nee Voigt
in Shanghai. Further investigation may be
possible if the Chinese characters for Dr. Chu's
name can be obtained.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sd. K. M. Bourne.
Commissioner of Police.

〔此处有手写签名〕

上海欧洲犹太难民援助委员会，
拨款与住房委员会，
天潼南路1号。

先生：

关于阁下1939年6月19日来函，经查询，在上海未找到艾拉·朱（Ella CHU），娘家姓福伊特（Voigt）女士的任何踪迹。若能获得朱博士姓名的中文字符，或许可以进行进一步调查。

此致，
敬礼

签署人 K. M. Bourne.
警务处长。

File No. __________
S.1. Special Branch __________
REPORT
Date July 6, 1939.

Subject (in full) Mrs. Ella CHU nee VOIGT - whereabouts

Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.I.

Despite lengthy enquiries made by Chinese and
foreign members of this office, no trace can be
found of Mrs. Ella CHU, nee VOIGT.
It would greatly facilitate this investigation
if the Chinese characters for Dr. Chu's name could
be forwarded by the party requiring the information.

Da. Pitts.
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

制作人：侦探员 Pitts 转呈人：巡长 C. Crawford.

尽管本处室的中外籍成员进行了长时间查询，仍未找到艾拉·朱（Ella CHU），娘家姓福伊特（VOIGT）女士的任何踪迹。

尊敬的先生们：

有一位名为艾拉·朱（Ella Chu），娘家姓福伊特（Voigt），嫁给朱奇（Chi Chu）博士的女士，据称居住在上海。由于我们无法追踪到她，如蒙告知贵处是否碰巧知道艾拉·朱女士的地址，我们将不胜感激。
